scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: _SENTRY_RELEASE=$(sentry-cli releases propose-version) && sentry-cli releases new $_SENTRY_RELEASE --org=zuedev --project=zue-dev && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org=zuedev --project=zue-dev --release=$_SENTRY_RELEASE --strip-prefix 'dist\..' dist
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps:windows: set _SENTRY_RELEASE=$(sentry-cli releases propose-version) && sentry-cli releases new %_SENTRY_RELEASE% --org=zuedev --project=zue-dev && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org=zuedev --project=zue-dev --release=%_SENTRY_RELEASE% --strip-prefix 'dist\..' dist
